subject: planner: fix intersection type mv index's filters mutations composition (#50379)
summary: Reviewed this commit diff vs first parent, focusing on planner MV-index IndexMerge(AND) composition. The change fixes filter-mutation collection so multiple predicates on the same MV virtual (array) column produce separate partial paths (intersection) without incorrectly stuffing multiple JSON predicates into a single accessFilter list (which would prevent building valid ranges). Checked the updated callers and range-building invariants; no plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found.
